therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Anti-idiotype antibody targeting CA-125 combined with PD-1 checkpoint inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhanced anti-tumor immune response through CA-125 targeting and T-cell activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Epithelial ovarian, tubal, or peritoneal cancer patients
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Overall response rate (ORR) as per GCIG criteria and progression-free survival (PFS)

results.dose_information: Nivolumab 240mg IV every 2 weeks; Oregovomab 0.5mg, 1mg, or 2mg IV every 4 weeks
